title: Closed immersions are separated, affine, integral and universally closed; composites of integral or universally closed morphisms
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then (a) $i$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]; (b) $i$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; (c) $i$ is integral (indeed finite) [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]; (d) $i$ is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Moreover, for morphisms of schemes $g:X\to Y$ and $h:Y\to W$: (e) if $g$ and $h$ are integral then $h\circ g$ is integral; (f) if $g$ and $h$ are universally closed then $h\circ g$ is universally closed.
